name: Agentic Patterns 3D Explorer
tagline: Multi-agent failures you can watch happen
description: Eight multi-agent design patterns as rotatable 3D scenes. Toggle tools, tracing and failure modes, and watch a pattern break live. Each failure is shown with the infrastructure fix that prevents it.
imageAlt: A 3D scene of a basic agent pattern: a human, an LLM, a tool and an MCP server connected by glowing data flows, with a control panel for faults and tracing.

name: window.ai
tagline: On-device AI APIs, right in the browser
description: A hands-on playground for Chrome's built-in AI — run models locally through the window.ai APIs, with no cloud round-trip and no API keys.

name: E2E Test AI Helper
tagline: AI-generated page objects for Cypress & Playwright
description: Scan a page, identify elements by a predefined attribute, and generate ready-to-use page-object code for your end-to-end tests — Cypress and Playwright supported.

name: LinkedIn Post Formatter
tagline: Bold, italic, and lists for LinkedIn posts
description: LinkedIn's composer has no rich text. This extension adds bold, italic, and list formatting so your posts actually stand out in the feed.
